---
title: "DuckDB can query Parquet over HTTP directly"
date: "2026-10-06"
categories: [duckdb, parquet]
---

No download step needed. With the `httpfs` extension, DuckDB reads a remote Parquet file in place:

```sql
SELECT * FROM 'https://example.com/data.parquet' LIMIT 10;
```

It only fetches the row groups and columns the query needs, so this stays fast even on large files.
